notable_absence.finding: No management-plane role, Support Plan, or edition gating appears anywhere - access is governed entirely by cluster access credentials, IP allowlisting, and a downloaded security certificate, none of which are org-role or plan-tier concepts.

cross_component_finding: A third instance, alongside cloud/security/auditing.json (Audit Event Reference) and cloud/billing/upgrade-account.json (cbbackupmgr) in this batch, of Capella docs deferring entirely to server/'s own CLI tool documentation (cbimport/cbexport) rather than maintaining Capella-native equivalents - this is now a recurring cross-product documentation-architecture pattern, not a one-off.
cross_product_finding: The command examples use a `couchbases://` connection string against a `*.cloud.couchbase.com` hostname with a `--cacert` flag - the same cbimport/cbexport CLI surface as self-managed Couchbase Server, just pointed at a Capella cluster address, reinforcing that this is literally the server/ tool rather than a Capella-specific rewrite.
